items.html: And when Adam HaRishon was created and performed practical commandments, he returned them to Panim be Panim [face to face]. And then there was no fear of the shells, for he had already dug and hoed and cleared the stones and cut the thorns from the vineyard. And behold, when they are Achor be Achor [back to back], ZON have but one wall for the two of them, and one wall alone suffices between them, and they use a single wall: half a wall for ZA and half a wall for the Nukva. And when man returned them to Panim be Panim through commandments and good deeds, then one complete posterior was finished and completed for this one and one complete posterior for that one, and they are able to turn Panim be Panim.
